title: Plan an AI companion product for your users
description: For businesses considering a companion toy, a clear brief starts with who will use it and the interaction you want to create.
considerations: Define the age group, usage setting and role of a parent or other supervising adult. Include the destination market and product expectations.
Write a short example of how the user should interact with the product. Explain what a suitable response looks like and how an unsuitable response should be handled.
List the topics, memory settings and controls you want to discuss. Agree how these requirements will be reviewed before the product is used.
Bring together your product design, brand requirements and evaluation criteria. Specific features and development conditions need to be confirmed.

title: Define an AI assistant around an office task
description: A useful project brief names the task, the information involved and the person who will review the result.
considerations: Describe how the task is completed today. Include the inputs, tools, expected output and situations that need human judgement.
List the documents and systems relevant to the task. Note who owns the information and which users should have access.
Decide which outputs need approval and what should happen when information is missing. Bring these requirements into the development discussion.
Use representative examples and an expected result to define the proposed evaluation. Features, system access and deployment are confirmed within the project scope.

title: Plan an AI wearable around its intended use
description: For an AI glasses project, start with the users, setting and tasks. Product functions and specifications need to be confirmed for the model you are considering.
considerations: Explain when and where the glasses would be used. Include the expected duration of use and the design requirements that matter to your users.
List the tasks you want the product to support and how users should interact with it. Separate essential requirements from features you would like to explore.
If a requested feature involves personal information, describe the expected handling, user controls and permissions. The actual approach needs to be confirmed in the product scope.
Include the target market, branding and documentation requirements. Agree the product scope and evaluation before planning supply.
